ambiguities.text: The exact timing and mechanics of 'rollups updating their posting strategies' is not specified
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume rollups must independently adjust their blob pricing algorithms to account for higher minimum fees, but no protocol-level coordination is required

ambiguities.text: The specification does not detail how the 'approximately 5.9 blocks' doubling rate was calculated
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume this is derived from the existing EIP-4844 exponential formula with the new minimum base fee parameter

implicit_assumptions.description: All clients will implement the fork activation reset correctly and synchronously
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Clients with incorrect reset logic could produce invalid blocks or reject valid blocks, causing chain splits

implicit_assumptions.description: Rollups have sufficient reserves or can adjust pricing quickly enough to handle increased minimum blob fees
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Rollups could experience temporary service disruptions or significantly increased operational costs

implicit_assumptions.description: The new minimum fee level (2^25 wei) is appropriate for market conditions and will not cause excessive costs during low demand periods
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Users may overpay for blob transactions during periods of low network activity
